findings.title: New and changed CLI exit codes are not asserted by tests
findings.body: This PR changes RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE from 4 to 3, introduces FEATURE_DISABLED=4, and documents that automation should rely only on the check command's exit code, but no test asserts those codes. testFeatureNotEnabled (line 47-50) checks only the error text for the metadata subcommand and does not assert exit code 4, there is no equivalent disabled-feature test for the check subcommand, and testWrongVersions (lines 86-107) does not assert exit code 3 for an incompatible result. A regression or a swapped/misreported exit code (consequential because 4 previously meant recreate) would therefore pass the suite while breaking scripts and consumers that follow the documented exit-code contract.
